programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Für Manny und Luke beginnen turbulente Zeiten, als sie die High-School beenden und ins Ungewisse aufbrechen. Während Manny ans College geht, begibt sich Luke auf die Suche nach seiner Berufung. Auch Haley scheint ihren Platz in der Berufswelt noch nicht ganz gefunden zu haben. Verzweifelt versucht sie, im Lifestyle-Journalismus Fuß zu fassen. Auch privat versucht Haley, Halt zu finden, und landet dabei zu Alex's Missfallen bei dessen Professor. Diese wiederum gibt sich große Mühe, ihrer Beziehung zu Ben innerhalb der Familie Anerkennung zu verschaffen. Derweil wollen Mitch und Claire ihre ursprüngliche Ablehnung gegenüber Jays und Glorias Beziehung wieder gut machen. Dafür organisieren sie eine Feier zu deren 10-jährigen Hochzeitstag. Die beiden konzentrieren sich indes auf Joes Erziehung. Damit erzielen sie jedoch nicht immer die gewünschten Effekte.

programme.title: The Wheelchair President
programme.desc: David Reynolds re-examines the war leadership of American president Franklin Roosevelt. At the height of war, Roosevelt inspired millions with stirring visions of a new and better post-war world, but it was a world he probably knew he would never see. He was commander-in-chief of the greatest military power the world had known, and yet a man whose paralysis from polio made him powerless to accomplish even the most minor physical tasks.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: In the Pacific, Americans are fighting on the island of Okinawa, gateway to Japan. Finally, on May 8th, with their country in ruins and their Fuehrer dead by his own hand, the Germans surrender.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Step to the left and jump to the beat, you better clap your hands and shuffle your feet, it's Duggee on the dance floor.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: While looking for things to sell in their shop, Bing and Sula find their old friend Mr Rainbow, but his head is completely gone. So they decide to sell him, and after a nice lady buys his stacky bit for her toilet rolls, they look for some more things to sell. But then they find Mr Rainbow's head and are sad that they can't get the rest of him back. However, Charlie loves to knock down Mr Rainbow's rings.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'cake' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. There is a small cake, a big cake, a banana cake and a carrot cake. There's a unicorn cake, a birthday cake and a wedding cake. Dee enjoys a wonderful rainbow-coloured surprise cake and is a little worried by an upside-down cake.

programme.title: Tralala

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou have a big fight, but they soon find it's too hard not to be friends.

programme.title: Twirlywoos

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends learn how to boogie board while Mr Tumble plays a game of tennis with Lord Tumble.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: When the lights go out in the Home Dome, the Teletubbies get the giggles. The lights come back on again and there's Tubby Custard mess everywhere.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rosa-May, Inam, Theo Joseph, George, Tobias and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone's bags are toothbrushes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate toothbrushes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsie plays I Spy next to a beautiful lake with her new friend Olivia.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie makes some tough choices when she decides to let go of a beloved musical item.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca is trying to win a lasso contest, but first, there's some making to be done with Murphy. A toothpaste box and a toothpaste tube are transformed into a toothpaste tube snake, the Mini Monsters create something beastly out of burger boxes, and Rebecca's cousin calls on the Magic Monster Mirror. Finally, a large cardboard tube provides inspiration for a terrific tube vulture.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Topsy is going to read Zebby a naptime story. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with the story, but they are all too loud and poor Zebby can't get to sleep. Can Raa Raa find any quiet sleepy noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While on a trip to the shops, Bingo and Bluey create issues for their parents when they insist on playing a game of `Kids'.

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Tahira wants to find out all about water voles. Chantelle heads up the river with some friends looking for signs of water voles, and Rory meets an expert on them in the city. Chantelle and Rory's fact files help answer all of Tahira's questions.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.sub-title: Queen Audrey Goes to the Beach
programme.desc: All rise for Queen Audrey. She plays a fun royal game and holds a special tea party for one of her favourite dolls. There are also lots of jewels and sparkles with some precious home-made necklaces.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen and Small are having a sleepover, but Small doesn't have a toothbrush that's her size. Dylan the dinosaur comes to visit, Small flies off to see how peppers grow, and the two friends cook up a falafel-saurus for their Jurassic guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they're worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and Katrina are visiting some schoolchildren on their very first day at school. Sylvie knows the children will be feeling nervous and excited all at once.

programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet a striated caracara and wolverines.

programme.title: Yukee

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how puddles play an important role in the environment. They find out that puddles are part of the water cycle and that they can support birds, animals, insects and plants too. They learn how raindrops and lakes can be a bit like puddles, and on the way, there is plenty of puddle-splashing fun to be had.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: As the children arrive, there is a rainbow over the school. Mrs Farrell points it out to Bryn before they head inside to create their own rainbow on the carpet. The rainbow has disappeared and the rain has stopped, so some of the children go outside for a game of hide-and-seek in the forest area. They soon find a hammock and take it in turns to try it out whilst the others sing a nursery rhyme. Back inside, it's time for some more nursery rhymes with music teacher Miss Usher.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Byddwn yn dysgu am awyrennau yn y bennod yma, a phwy wnaeth ddyfeisio ac adeiladu'r awyren gyntaf. A lesson on aeroplanes and the person responsible for the invention of the aeroplane.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto a Lili'n achub Benja o dy Mr Puw ac mae Guto'n dod o hyd i hen luniau ffilm o'i dad. Guto and Lili rescue Benja from Mr Puw's house and Guto finds old film footage of his father.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Y Castell sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Y Castell join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland-themed games.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Mae Ysgol Gymraeg Y Trallwng yn hen a llawn a phawb eisiau ysgol newydd; heddiw cawn glywed beth yw eu cynlluniau i newid hyn. We hear if Ysgol Gymraeg Y Trallwng is getting a new school.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae Enfys wedi llwyddo i glymu ei hun yn gwlwm ac felly mae'n rhaid i'r Cymylaubychain ei helpu gyda'r gwaith. Rainbow is in a knot and needs some help to get free again.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae ymbarel Tanwen, cyflwynydd y tywydd, wedi torri. Mae hi'n gwneud apêl yn fyw ar y teledu ac aiff Harri ac Alex i'w helpu. Tanwen, the weather forecaster's umbrella has broken. Help!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae'r syrcas yn dod i Swopdre Fawr ac mae Mojo yn helpu Bo gyda'i berfformiad mentrus. It's Swoptops in the Big Top as Mojo helps Bo with a daring circus performance!

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Sut mae Anni'n bwriadu cael gwared ar y bananas ych a fi mae Mam-Gu wedi roi yn ei bocs bwyd? How will Anni get rid of the yucky bananas that Mam-gu's put in her lunchbox?

programme.title: Mari, Hari a'r Byd Tanddwr
programme.desc: Heddiw, mae dau archwiliwr tanddwr yn ymuno â nhw wrth iddyn nhw gyfarch eu ffrind rownd a fflat, Morgan y forgath! Discover all about Mari and Hari's friend, Morgan the stingray!

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Yn y ffair mae Joni'n awyddus i chwarae'r gemau fel y myn, tra ceisia Jason ddysgu gwerth strategaeth iddo. Joni is keen to play the fair games as he wants, while Jason values strategy.

programme.title: Caban Jam Gareth
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yn galw heibio Ysgol Teilo Sant lle mae'r criw eisiau cân am ei hoff fwyd: pitsa! Gareth goes to Ysgol Teilo Sant where the crew want a song about their favourite food: pizza!

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae pysgodyn wedi diflannu o bwll Tad-cu - mae Ger a Gu yn amau nad y creyr plastig sydd ar fai! When a fish disappears from Tad-cu's pond, Ger and Gu suspect that something fishy is going on!

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Hywel Hwyl yn glanhau cartrefi'r anifeiliaid, ond mae'n cael damwain efo Madam Fflwffen y gwningen. Hywel Hwyl cleans the animals' homes but has an accident with Madam Fflwffen the bunny.

programme.title: Byd Carlo Bach
programme.desc: With his special cloak, Carlo pretends to be a superhero. But will his friends be happy to have a formidable bear among them?

programme.title: Egin Bach
programme.desc: Wrth i flodyn dant y llew wywo yn y gwres, mae Pico'n ceisio ei ddyfrio gyda diferyn o wlith. As a daisy wilts in the heat, Pico tries to water it with a dewdrop.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: Jen and the Submarine are having difficulty understanding directions. Can Jim and Capten Carys help them learn the difference between up and down and forward and backwards?

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: The Abadas love playing hide and seek. Today's word is also able to seek out things that can't be seen. What could it be and which Abada would be the best one to go and look for the word?

programme.title: Kim a Cai a Cranc
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cai ar antur hudolus a chwareus yn llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am gragen newydd i Cranc. Joining Kim and Cai as they search for a new shell for Cranc.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd

programme.title: Dan Do
programme.desc: Ymweliad a thy wedi ei adnewyddu o gragen hen feudy ger Dolgellau, adeilad newydd sbon yn Llangoedmor, a chartre sy'n gymaint mwy na jesd rhywle i fyw. Interesting Welsh homes.

programme.title: Stiwdio24/7
programme.desc: Perfformiadau gan Papur Wal, Dadleoli, Georgia Ruth, Endaf a Mali Haf. This time, performances by Papur Wal, Dadleoli, Georiga Ruth, Endaf and Mali Haf.

programme.desc: Mae Bryn yn coginio stecen, tatws a madarch ar gyfer Rhodri, fferm Brynllech Uchaf, Llanuwchllyn. Bryn barbecues a T-bone steak, potato and mushroom for Rhodri from Brynllech Uchaf.

programme.title: Portmeirion
programme.desc: Dathlu canmlwyddiant Portmeirion.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
programme.desc: Newyddion a thywydd. Coverage of a wide range of news topics and weather with expert commentary and analysis by BBC Wales correspondents.

programme.title: Prynhawn Da
programme.desc: Cyfres gylchgrawn gydag eitemau coginio a ffasiwn a chyngor am bopeth o addurno'ch cartref i ddewis llyfr da. Magazine series including features on fashion, style, antiques and cookery.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
programme.desc: Newyddion a thywydd. Coverage of a wide range of news topics and weather with expert commentary and analysis by BBC Wales correspondents.

programme.title: Hydref Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd Iolo Williams am fywyd gwyllt yr hydref: brain coesgoch yn dawnsio, piod y môr mewn storm, carlwm yn hela & llawer mwy. Iolo Williams explores autumn wildlife with chough dancing, oystercatchers in a storm, stoats hunting and more.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn mynd ar y trên heddiw. Allwch chi gofio swn y trên er mwyn canu gyda nhw ar y daith? Harmoni, Melodi and Bop are riding on a train today.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd ac nid yw'n hoffi pethau newydd. When mum buys a new sofa, Pablo's not happy until the animals persuade him to believe that it's just like the old one!

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cêt ar antur hudolus a chwareus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am Twrch yn y goedwig. Join Kim and Cêt on a magical and playful adventure.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae awyren Preston mewn trafferth, mae Mojo ar ei ôl yn y top jet! Preston's stunt plane is in trouble, and Mojo's right on his tail in the jet top!

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n ddiwrnod prysur yn Parc Glan Gwil ac mae tipyn o waith i'w wneud cyn bod y gwersyllwyr newydd yn cyrraedd. Another busy day and there's a lot of work left before the campers arrive.

programme.title: Lôn Dirgelion
programme.desc: Mae Champollion yn galw ar Clyfar pan mae ei feistr yn cael ei herwgipio gan robot. Champollion calls on Clyfar when his master gets abducted by a robot.

programme.title: Y Ras Arian
programme.desc: Mae'r timau heddiw - o ysgolion Bro Myrddin a Chaer Elen - yn cychwyn ail ran y ras yn Glanyfferi. 2 teams get 2 days to race 100 miles across Wales with £100.

programme.title: Newyddion Ni
programme.desc: Newyddion i bobl ifanc. News programme for youngsters.

programme.desc: Y tro hwn, mae brawd Colleen, Scott, yn dod i helpu creu pryd i'w rhieni. This time, Colleen's brother Scott joins her to cook a meal for her parents.

programme.title: Rownd a Rownd
programme.desc: Mae Ken wedi dychryn o ddarganfod fod Kay ar goll, a Dylan yn ceisio siarad yn gall efo Sophie. Ken's shocked when he discovers that Kay's missing, and Dylan tries his best to talk to Sophie.

programme.title: The Wheelchair President
programme.desc: David Reynolds re-examines the war leadership of American president Franklin Roosevelt. At the height of war, Roosevelt inspired millions with stirring visions of a new and better post-war world, but it was a world he probably knew he would never see. He was commander-in-chief of the greatest military power the world had known, and yet a man whose paralysis from polio made him powerless to accomplish even the most minor physical tasks.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: An epic historical drama set in the 12th century in which Henry II summons his fragmented family to a reunion. There follows a series of battles, both political and personal, as his wife Eleanor and her three sons scheme to further their own claim to the king's empire.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.title: Jaws III
programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: GoodFellas
programme.desc: Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
